hints.title: Calculating Monster Arrival Minutes
hints.text: Calculate the exact arrival time for each monster: arrival_time = ceil(dist[i] / speed[i]).

hints.title: Sorting by Earliest Arrival
hints.text: sort the arrival times in ascending order.

hints.title: Greedy Elimination Check
hints.text: at minute i (0, 1, 2, ...), the weapon eliminates one monster. If arrival_time <= i, the monster reached the city first and you lose.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Arrival times computed and sorted; loop checks if weapon can eliminate each monster before arrival.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating monster movement minute by minute takes O(max_distance * N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Computing arrival times and sorting takes O(N log N) time and O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should convert distance and speed into arrival time and apply greedy earliest-arrival-first.
